title: LETTER 6: Letter to Bank Manager — Request to Waive Processing Fee

blocks.content: Topic: Write a letter to your bank's Branch Manager requesting waiver of the home loan processing fee, citing your long banking relationship and government employment.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Maintain a strictly professional, polite, and persuasive tone throughout the letter.
Always quote the reference numbers such as Loan Application ID, Account Number, or Sanction Letter reference.
Provide a valid justification for the waiver request, such as a long-standing banking relationship or impeccable credit history.
State the exact processing fee amount or percentage requested for waiver clearly in the body.
Follow standard formal letter conventions, including sender details, date, designation, subject line, salutation, and sign-off.

blocks.content: I request you to kindly consider waiving the processing fee as a special gesture, keeping in view my long-standing association and flawless credit track record with your bank.
Subject: Request for Waiver of Processing Fee on Home Loan Application No. HL-2025-04421

rows: Mentions specific Loan Application ID and account relationship history.
Omits account details or reference numbers.
Politely requests waiver based on loyalty, clean credit score, or promotional context.
Demands fee reduction aggressively without justification.
Follows crisp formal layout with concise 3-paragraph structure.
Uses informal language or lengthy irrelevant narrative.

blocks.content: I am Dr. Anita Bose, a Savings and Fixed Deposit account holder with your branch for the past twelve years (Savings Account No. BOB-3300112234). I have always maintained a healthy account relationship, with an average monthly balance well above the required minimum, and have utilised several banking services including internet banking, locker, and mutual fund investments through your branch.

I recently submitted an application for a home loan of Rs. 48,00,000 for the purchase of a residential flat at Civil Lines, Bhopal. I am informed that the standard processing fee applicable is Rs. 12,000 plus applicable GST. As a government employee with a confirmed salary, a clean credit history (CIBIL Score: 792), and a twelve-year banking relationship with your branch, I humbly request you to kindly consider waiving or reducing the processing fee as a mark of appreciation for my continued patronage.

I also wish to mention that several competing banks in the city are currently offering zero processing fee as part of their festive loan campaigns. I would, however, prefer to continue my banking relationship with Bank of Baroda, and a waiver would further strengthen my loyalty to your institution.
I would be grateful if you could consider this request favourably and inform me of your decision at your earliest convenience.

items: Ensure the subject line explicitly includes the core request alongside the loan application/account number.
Avoid aggressive or demanding tone; requests for fee waivers rely on goodwill and customer track record.
Descriptive exams award marks for correct layout structure: Sender Address, Date, Receiver Address, Subject, Salutation, Body, and Subscription.

blocks.content: Examiner's Tip: Request letters should combine a polite appeal with rational justification. Mention specific relationship tenure, account numbers, and credit score to make the case stronger. A reference to competition creates urgency without being confrontational.
